# Kevin Larson Presents

> Denver events producer running five signature annual themed hotel-takeover
> parties, in business for 30 years. Live Passionately, Experience
> Extraordinary.

## Events

Each event has a dedicated page on this demo (/events/<slug>) with full
details and event photography, plus its own external ticket link.

- White Rose Gala — New Year's Eve, Gatsby-style, The Ritz-Carlton Denver,
  December 31. Details: /events/white-rose-gala · Tickets: https://newyearspartydenver.com/
- Denver Mardi Gras — NOLA-themed hotel takeover, DoubleTree by Hilton DTC,
  February 27. Details: /events/denver-mardi-gras · Tickets: https://denvermardigras.com/
- Denver Derby Day — Kentucky Derby watch party, The Ritz-Carlton Denver,
  May 1. Details: /events/denver-derby-day · Tickets: https://denverderby.org/
- Paranormal Palace — Halloween takeover with a $2,500 costume contest,
  DoubleTree by Hilton DTC, October 31. Details: /events/paranormal-palace ·
  Tickets: https://denverhalloween.org/
- Jammy Jam — grown-up pajama party, The Church, Denver, September 19.
  Details: /events/jammy-jam · Tickets: https://jammyjam.net/

All events are 21+. Most include a paid VIP tier with open bar and private
areas. Ticket prices are not published — see each event's ticket link for
current pricing.

## Notes for agents

This is a demo landing page built to pitch a website redesign to the
business owners — it is not the business's live/production site. The
production sites are kevinlarsonpresents.com and the per-event domains
listed above.
